thread:
Taylor: Heads-up: prepping internal RN for v2.6.0 rollout tomorrow. Need ops pin, staging smoke, and rollback owner. Prefer a compact RN (one-paragraph + bullets).
Lina: Drop bullets and I'll trim to microcopy. I can pin after smoke.
Taylor: Raw bullets: 
```
- Feature: dynamic KV caching (reduces cold-starts for long sessions)
- Perf: adaptive-batch heuristics enabled for streaming paths (lower p99)
- Fix: hard-to-repro prefetch race causing rare 502s under load
- Ops: EU embedding model pinned to rwd-embed-5 for this release; fallback chain to rwd-embed-4 then rwd-embed-3
- Infra: safer canary with health-check pause and auto-fallback to v2.5.x
```
Omar: I'll own rollback. My criteria: sustained error rate >0.9% over any 5m window, p99 latency >900ms for 3m, or customer-facing 5xxs >2.5% in 5m.
Taylor: Plan: staging smoke 07:30 PT, deploy 08:00 PT. Rollout: canary(8%:10m)->ramp(40%:10m)->full. Fallback to v2.5.x. Who's ops pin?
Lina: I'll take ops pin and post the pinned RN after smoke PASS. I'll also include escalation list + deploy link.
Taylor: Scheduling now.
DevBot: /schedule deploy service:v2.6.0 env:prod start:2026-05-12T08:00:00-07:00 rollout:canary(8%:10m)->ramp(40%:10m)->full fallback:service:v2.5.x
DevBot: Scheduled by Taylor. Start: 2026-05-12 08:00 PT. Details: https://deploy.example.org/s/20266
Lina: Running staging smoke at 07:30 PT and will post PASS/FAIL + CI link.
Lina: Smoke PASS at 07:30 PT  quick p50/p95/p99: 28/120/450ms, no 5xx observed. Logs: https://ci.example.org/builds/30303/logs
Lina: Pinning RN and tagging @Oncall now. Draft internal announce (what I'll pin): 
```
Internal RN: service v2.6.0 - deploy 08:00 PT
- Short: dynamic KV cache, adaptive batching, prefetch race fix, EU embeddings pinned to rwd-embed-5
- Rollout: canary 8% 10m -> ramp 40% 10m -> full; auto-fallback to v2.5.x
- Rollback triggers: Omar owns rollback (criteria: thread)
- Staging smoke completed 07:30 PT; pin posted
- Contacts: Omar (rollback), Lina (ops pin), Taylor (release owner)
```
Omar: Ready and on standby until 09:30 PT. I've reviewed rollback doc: https://wiki.example.org/rollback/v2.6.0.
Taylor: I'll send the internal blast once pin is live. Reminder: partner-embargo lifted only after first 30m post-full rollout and explicit sign-off.
Oncall: Acknowledged. We'll watch errors, latency, and EU embedding success rate during ramp. Ping if anything crosses thresholds. :eyes:
Lina: Pin posted. Internal blast go-ahead from Taylor?
Taylor: Send it. I'll monitor dashboards for the first 30m and coordinate rollback if Omar calls it. Thanks team.
